content.text: Observable, the browser aborts the request. That only stops the browser from waiting for an answer. If the request already reached the server, the server may still process it; your app just never learns the result. For a search, that's harmless. For a write, it means a side effect you can't see: a duplicate order, a deleted row that's still in your list, or an autosave of older text that lands after newer text.
